subject: planner: add error as return value for predicate-push-down (#62258)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: it mechanically extends `LogicalPlan.PredicatePushDown` to return `(rest, newRoot, error)` and threads the error through logical operators and `PPDSolver.Optimize`. Callers either propagate the error immediately or return it to the optimizer; optimizer rule application already aborts on non-nil error without dereferencing the returned plan. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the planner changes.
